{{Wiktionary|{{PAGENAME}}}}
'''Petersen''' is a common [[Danish language|Danish]] [[patronymic]] [[surname]], meaning ''"son of [[Peter (name)|Peter]]"''.<ref>{{cite book |last=Sørensen |first=John Kousgård |title=Patronymer i Danmark: Runetid og middelalder |publisher=Akademisk forlag |date=1984 |isbn=978-87-500-2510-8 |url=https://www.google.com/books/edition/Patronymer_i_Danmark_Runetid_og_middelal/ZmNmAAAAMAAJ |language=da |access-date=12 July 2026 |page=12}}</ref> '''Petersén''' is a Swedish orthographic variant.
{{TOC right}}
